title: Bitcoin ordinals and inscriptions drive on-chain activity su
content: TL;DR: Bitcoin's base layer is experiencing a significant surge in activity, driven by the continued adoption of Ordinals and Inscriptions, pushing block space demand and transaction fees upward. This phenomenon is vigorously testing and strengthening Bitcoin's fee market, demonstrating the network's permissionless utility and reinforcing its long-term security model as "The Hardest Money." Transactors must adapt to a competitive block space environment, leveraging tools and strategies to optimize their on-chain operations.
author: Al Ingle
